data.name: Shubhankar
data.long_meaning: Shubhankar is a name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘shubh’ which means ‘auspicious’ or ‘good fortune’ and ‘ankar’ which means ‘to bring’ or ‘to carry’. This name is therefore a beautiful and meaningful name for a baby boy, as it suggests that he will be a bringer of good luck and prosperity in the lives of those around him.
data.spiritual_meaning: Shubhankar is a name that carries deep spiritual significance. It is believed that the name embodies the divine energies of Lakshmi, the Hindu goddess of wealth, prosperity, and good fortune. By giving this name to a baby boy, parents are essentially invoking the blessings of Lakshmi and imbuing their child with the qualities of generosity, kindness, and abundance.
